description: Numbering a new plan in a mature project whose plans/ directory is empty in the tree but whose history has added plans 0001-0004, the highest (0004) just completed and removed: the next number increments past the highest ever added (0005), rather than reusing the retired top number (0004), counting the empty tree (0001), or copying the ADR number (0006). Reproduces the production duplicate-0004 defect.
